name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
changes.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.

changes.title: Daily fragment: Nyonoksa radiation accident
changes.summary: An explosion at the State Central Navy Testing Range in Nyonoksa, Russia, kills five people.

changes.title: As Ukraine Strikes Wildberries, Russia’s Richest Businesswoman Faces Her Biggest Test Yet
changes.summary: As Ukraine repeatedly strikes warehouses of the e-commerce site Wildberries, Tatyana Kim, its billionaire co-founder, faces her biggest test yet.

changes.title: She Is Russia’s Richest Woman. Her Business Empire Is Going Up in Flames.
changes.summary: As Ukraine repeatedly strikes warehouses of the e-commerce site Wildberries, Tatyana Kim, its billionaire co-founder, faces her biggest test yet.

changes.title: Advocates for former U.S. Marine held for years in Russia say he is near death
changes.summary: A former U.S. Marine held in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges is gravely ill and at risk of dying, his family and advocates said Friday.

changes.title: Senate passes Russia sanctions bill that was long championed by Lindsey Graham
changes.summary: The bill is meant to stifle Russia's economy by allowing for tough new tariffs against major importers of Russian energy. The legislation was led by Lindsey Graham before his unexpected death in July. (Image credit: Heather Diehl).

changes.title: Senate Passes Sanctions Bill Targeting Russia and Iran
changes.summary: The legislation was championed by Senator Lindsey Graham, the South Carolina Republican whose sudden death last month helped spur quick action on it.

changes.title: Family of Former U.S. Marine Detained in Russia Says He Is in Serious Condition
changes.summary: Robert Gilman, 32, is in “dissociative stupor,” an advocacy group said, and his family members say they are afraid for his life. Mr. Gilman was arrested in Russia in 2022.

changes.title: Blanche on track for narrow Senate confirmation as attorney general
changes.summary: At the U.S. Capitol, it was a wild day of decision and indecision. The Senate passed the toughest sanctions bill on Russia yet and is also now on track to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general. But a slew of other high-priority items are still tangled, largely due to a Republican divide. Congressional correspondent.

changes.title: U.S. Marine vet, detained in Russia since 2022, hospitalized in serious condition
changes.summary: Robert Gilman, 32, is being held at a Russian hospital in what his advocate, Eric Lebson of Global Reach, described as a "dissociative stupor.".
